headline: Saudi Arabia has raised oil exports to 6 million barrels per day
summary: Riyadh has increased crude supplies to the global market despite the suspension of operations on a key oil pipeline. The report gives no further details on the pipeline.
why: Saudi Arabia is the largest exporter in OPEC and its output decisions strongly influence global crude prices.
